# WinStorePackager

Canonical repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/WinStorePackager
Organization: file-bricks
Primary audience: Python desktop app developers preparing Microsoft Store submissions.

## Summary

WinStorePackager is a local-first Windows GUI and CLI utility for preparing Python desktop applications for Microsoft Store packaging. It generates AppxManifest metadata, required multi-resolution Store icons, project profile JSONs, screenshot assets, and MSIX/AppX build inputs with OS Keyring cryptographic certificate security.

## Key Files

- `SKILL.md`: Standalone product usage skill for AI agents and automated assistants (Policy P-022).

- `README_hi.md`: Hindi full World-Set documentation guide (15-section parity, lifecycle diagrams, Store workflows).
- `README_bn.md`: Bengali full World-Set documentation guide (15-section parity, lifecycle diagrams, Store workflows).
- `SECURITY.md`: Bilingual security policy with Local-First, Zero-Egress, and OS Keyring guarantees.
- `WindowsStorePublisher_3.py`: Desktop GUI entry point with 6-language runtime i18n support (DE, EN, ES, ZH, JA, RU; documentation covers the 11-language World-Set).
- `PROJECT_PROFILE_FORMAT.md`: `winstorepackager-project-v1` exchange format.
- `PRIVACY_POLICY.md`: Local-data and privacy boundary.
- `STORE_LISTING.md`: Reusable Microsoft Store listing copy.
- `unix_preflight.py`: Cross-platform preflight validation script (Linux / macOS / CI).
- `manage_translations.py`: 6-language catalog scanner and `--check` CI parity gate.
- `scripts/check_store_readiness.py`: Automated Windows Store readiness and listing preflight checker.
- `NOTICE`: Canonical copyright, open-bricks ecosystem attribution, and license references.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`: Dependency inventory with SPDX licenses, vulnerability floors, and zero-egress invariants.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: Multi-OS CI testing matrix (Ubuntu, Windows, macOS across Python 3.9-3.13) with concurrency control, timeout-minutes guardrails, and bytecode gate.
- `.github/workflows/welcome.yml`: Contributor onboarding workflow with actions/first-interaction@v3, concurrency control, and timeout-minutes guardrails.
- `.github/workflows/stale.yml`: Automated issue/PR lifecycle hygiene with actions/stale@v9, daily cron schedule, and concurrency control.
- `tests/test_metadata.py`: Automated contract suite for metadata, badges, P-022 entrypoints, and discoverability.

## Audience

- Solo Python developers who want to submit a desktop app to the Microsoft Store and need a local GUI for the repetitive packaging steps (manifests, icons, screenshots, MSIX)
- Small teams preparing Store listings and metadata without setting up Visual Studio projects per app
- Developers on Windows who want a reproducible local workflow from Python source to signed MSIX
- Bioinformatics, research, or tool developers who have a working PySide6/PyQt6 app and want to distribute it via the Store

## Scope Boundary

WinStorePackager is not the official Microsoft MSIX Packaging Tool and does not submit apps to Partner Center. It prepares local metadata, icons, manifests, screenshots, and build inputs for developers who already have the Windows SDK and a Microsoft Store developer account. It is not a web app, cloud service, Android app, or iOS product line.

## Privacy Boundary

Local Publisher IDs, certificate paths, passwords, SDK paths, generated manifests, MSIX/AppX packages, WACK logs, and release bundles stay outside Git. Runtime settings and rotating logs live outside the checkout in host-local directories; certificate passwords remain in the operating-system Keyring. Project profile exports intentionally omit sensitive Windows-specific values.

## Verification & Test Suite

Tested with Pytest: 215 collected tests (214 passed, 1 skipped in the local run when optional local MSIX artifacts are absent). Execute via `python -m pytest -ra -v`.
